title: Not-Null Assertion
learning_outcomes: Explain the central rule or purpose of not-null assertion using at least one correct term from the lesson.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Not-Null Assertion** as part of **Null Safety and Type Handling**. The `!!` operator converts a nullable value to its non-null type but throws if the value is null; prefer safe handling when possible. Use the subtopics—The !! Operator, Runtime Failure Risks, Safer Alternatives—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Functions, null safety, strings, and collections are the building blocks of most practical Kotlin code. Choosing the right operation reduces avoidable errors and makes behavior easier to test.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: The `!!` operator converts a nullable value to its non-null type but throws if the value is null; prefer safe handling when possible.

content_blocks.title: Common mistake to avoid
content_blocks.text: The compiler can guarantee that a Java platform value never contains null.
